productWalkthrough.heroTitle: Tailor every resume to the job without inventing a thing.
productWalkthrough.heroSubtitle: Watheq helps you turn one existing resume into a targeted application for each job ad with job matching, clarifying questions, Saudi-market context, ATS improvement, and interview preparation.
productWalkthrough.heroNote: No fake experience. No generic rewrite.
productWalkthrough.stageSubtitle: Start with your real resume and the job ad. Watheq highlights fit, asks before rewriting, and keeps suggestions grounded in your evidence.
productWalkthrough.finalTitle: Build a resume that proves fit before you apply.

heroProof.title: Senior Business Analyst application
items: Parses resume evidence before suggesting changes.
Asks clarifying questions when the impact is underspecified.
Shows ATS lift, matched keywords, and an improved bullet.

clarifyQuestions: What business decision did the reporting improve?
How many stakeholders used the dashboard?
Can you verify the time or cost saved?
preview.visionDescription: Identify where the role connects to Saudi growth sectors, localization priorities, and bilingual evidence already present in the resume.
preview.interviewTitle: Interview prep from the same evidence
interviewQuestions: Tell me about a dashboard that changed a business decision.
How did you handle competing stakeholder priorities?
Which Vision 2030 sector experience is most relevant here?
preview.interviewReady: Practice answers with the same claims used in the tailored resume.
